s: stand-up-only laneway coffee bar once named Australia's best
w: A tiny stand-up-only coffee window tucked behind Little Bourke Street in the CBD laneways, with no seats and a rotating guest-roaster line-up alongside its own beans. Named Best Coffee in Australia at the Golden Bean Awards, it draws queues of city workers who drink their flat whites standing in the alley.
_facts: Located at the rear of 493-495 Little Bourke Street, Melbourne VIC 3000
Stand-up laneway coffee bar with no seating
Named Best Coffee in Australia at the Golden Bean Awards
